currency_rule: US estimates are USD and Canadian estimates are CAD. No currency conversion was performed.
inclusion_rule: At least two usable current public sources with a compatible pricing unit. Promotions, memberships, new-patient offers, and manufacturer rewards were excluded from regular estimates.
calculation_rule: Low and high are the observed regular-price bounds. For three or more sources, average and median use one representative regular value per source; the midpoint represents a published range. With only two sources, average and median are null because the sample is too small.

estimates.methodology_note: Used Epi Center's $16 list price, Nob Hill's $18 nonmember price, and the midpoint of Serenity's 2026 regular-market $15–$20 range.
estimates.limitations: Clinic experience, required units, neighbourhood, and prescriber fees vary; membership and new-patient prices were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained each clinic's raw advertised Dysport-unit price without any Botox-equivalent conversion.
estimates.limitations: The unusually wide range likely reflects different billing conventions; Dysport and Botox potency units are not interchangeable.

estimates.methodology_note: Used one midpoint or representative regular per-syringe value from each source; only clearly labelled 1 mL/cc products were included.
estimates.limitations: Products, areas, and injector tiers differ. Multi-syringe discounts and memberships were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two published regular 1 mL Kysse prices in the broader Bay Area/North Bay market.
estimates.limitations: Only two clinics qualified; injection fee and geographic spread within the Bay Area may differ.

estimates.methodology_note: Used the stated $900 Epi Center regular value before its promotion and Morpheus Medical Aesthetics' $750 one-vial price.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources; typical plans use multiple vials and sessions. Promotional package price was excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used each clinic's regular nonmember per-unit price; package, one-time, and membership discounts were excluded.
estimates.limitations: Unit need and injector tier are not captured; some clinics impose minimum purchases.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained raw regular Dysport-unit prices exactly as advertised; no dose conversion or Botox-equivalent normalization.
estimates.limitations: Some clinics appear to use a unified toxin billing convention, causing a wide range; actual Dysport units are non-interchangeable with Botox units.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular 1 mL HA-filler values or the midpoint of each clinic's regular facial-filler range.
estimates.limitations: The mix includes multiple HA products and treatment areas; structural products can cost more. Membership values were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Combined two clinic regular prices with the midpoint of a June 2026 verified-directory range.
estimates.limitations: The marketplace range includes premium physician practices; area and injector fee vary.

estimates.methodology_note: Combined two clinic regular prices with the midpoint of a June 2026 verified-directory range.
estimates.limitations: Lip technique, injector tier, and consultation fees are not captured.

estimates.methodology_note: Used three regular clinic per-vial prices and the midpoint of a verified-directory range.
estimates.limitations: Number of vials and sessions drives total cost; physician-injector premiums and package discounts are excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used two regular clinic prices and the midpoint of a June 2026 market range.
estimates.limitations: Radiesse and Radiesse (+), facial versus hand use, dilution, and injector tier can change price.

estimates.methodology_note: Used Skinsation's $950 regular face-and-neck price and the directory's current LA RF-microneedling range, with the range retained rather than averaged.
estimates.limitations: One source is category-wide and area definitions differ; package and membership prices were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used the midpoint of Elite's regular range and the two clinics' regular per-unit values.
estimates.limitations: Master-injector tier, minimum purchase, and area-specific flat pricing are not included.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained each clinic's raw regular Dysport-unit pricing without conversion.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources and both use combined toxin menus; Dysport units remain non-interchangeable.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared Elite's regular area range with Ratio's full-syringe regular price; no average was calculated because billing units are not perfectly identical.
estimates.limitations: One source bills by area and the other by syringe; use the range for orientation only.

estimates.methodology_note: Used each clinic's regular one-vial public price.
estimates.limitations: Total course often includes multiple vials and visits; promotions and coupon codes were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular clinic per-unit menu values.
estimates.limitations: Some menus combine toxin brands and provider tiers; required unit count is not estimated.

estimates.methodology_note: Used raw advertised Dysport-unit values from combined toxin menus; no conversion was performed.
estimates.limitations: Identical raw price does not imply dose equivalence with Botox.

estimates.methodology_note: Used 4Beauty's regular $750 family starting prices and the current marketplace's structural-filler range.
estimates.limitations: One source is a marketplace aggregate and exact product, area, and syringe count vary.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular one-vial or one-session/one-vial menu prices for facial Sculptra.
estimates.limitations: Provider-specific treatment plans may use multiple vials; no package price was included.

estimates.methodology_note: Used 4Beauty's $1,200 full-face regular price and the current marketplace range.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources; package, face-and-neck, and add-on pricing were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular public per-unit values and excluded membership prices.
estimates.limitations: One source includes provider-tier alternatives; only standard listed prices were used.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained raw Dysport-unit menu prices and excluded memberships; no dose conversion.
estimates.limitations: The range suggests different clinic billing conventions; raw units cannot be compared with Botox units.

estimates.methodology_note: Used each clinic's regular full-syringe product range or representative portfolio value.
estimates.limitations: Specific product and area materially affect price; half-syringe and membership prices were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular public Voluma 1 mL syringe prices.
estimates.limitations: Total cost depends on number of syringes and area; injector tier is not normalized.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two regular public Kysse 1 mL prices.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources; lip technique and injector tier are not captured.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular public per-vial facial prices.
estimates.limitations: Full plans commonly require multiple vials and sessions.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared regular one-syringe menu values.
estimates.limitations: Syringe volume, Radiesse versus Radiesse (+), and treatment area require confirmation.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular face-session prices for comparable Signature/standard protocols; sale and membership prices were excluded.
estimates.limitations: Protocol length and included boosters differ; deluxe and platinum tiers were not mixed into the representative value.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular public per-unit values; the midpoint represented Shah's provider-tier range.
estimates.limitations: Provider tier and required units vary; memberships and promotions were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained raw regular Dysport-unit prices with the midpoint for a provider-tier range.
estimates.limitations: Several Chicago menus use unified toxin prices; no cross-brand unit conversion was made.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared published regular Juvéderm product/provider ranges.
estimates.limitations: Specific product, provider tier, and syringe size drive the quote.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared published regular Restylane family/provider ranges.
estimates.limitations: Specific product, provider tier, and treatment area are not normalized.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular one-vial values and the midpoint of the provider-tier range.
estimates.limitations: One clinic publishes a starting price; total plan often includes multiple vials.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared one clinic's provider-tier range with another clinic's regular one-syringe price.
estimates.limitations: Exact syringe volume and area should be confirmed.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular public face-session values and the midpoint of one protocol range.
estimates.limitations: Express, Signature, and upgraded protocols differ in duration and included boosters.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular nonmember per-unit prices from Toronto clinics.
estimates.limitations: Prescriber/injector tier, HST treatment, and unit need vary; packages were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained each clinic's raw regular Dysport-unit price and excluded packages and memberships.
estimates.limitations: Raw Dysport units are not Botox-equivalent units.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular one-syringe filler prices; Signature's lower regular Restylane tier represented that source.
estimates.limitations: Brand, product, area, and injector tier differ; multi-syringe packages were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used Signature's regular vial price, Precision's two-vial regular price divided by two, and ART's one-vial regular price.
estimates.limitations: Precision publishes a two-vial total; total course and physician-injector tier vary.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two regular one-syringe public prices.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources; syringe version, volume, and area should be confirmed.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared ART's regular full-face-and-neck session with Bar Beauty's regular face-and-neck session.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources; anesthesia, tip, and package pricing were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Used Signature's 900-pulse face price and ID Cosmetic's published Toronto full-face Thermage FLX range.
estimates.limitations: Pulse count and face-versus-face-and-neck scope differ across quotes.

estimates.methodology_note: Retained overlapping current clinic and marketplace full-treatment ranges rather than calculating a two-source midpoint.
estimates.limitations: Line count and exact area vary, and one source is a marketplace listing.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two regular per-unit clinic prices.
estimates.limitations: One clinic groups neuromodulators under one price; unit need and prescriber fees vary.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared Medical Rejuvenation Centre's regular 1 mL portfolio price with Azin Yazdani's public starting syringe price.
estimates.limitations: One value is a starting price; specific product and area materially affect cost.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two public starting/one-bottle values.
estimates.limitations: Both may be starting prices; multi-vial course cost is not estimated.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared one starting price and one fixed public price.
estimates.limitations: Only two sources; product version and treatment area vary.

estimates.methodology_note: Used Vancouver Laser's public starting price and the current Vancouver directory's full-face range.
estimates.limitations: One source is a starting price and one is a marketplace aggregate; pulse count is not normalized.

estimates.methodology_note: Used Vancouver Laser's starting price and the current directory's full-face range.
estimates.limitations: Line count, Ultherapy versus Ultherapy Prime, and exact area vary; one source is a marketplace aggregate.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two regular public per-unit prices.
estimates.limitations: One source says 'from'; consultation and prescriber fees may apply.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared La Clé's starting price with Ideal Body Clinic's regular Juvéderm and Restylane values.
estimates.limitations: Specific product, syringe volume, treatment area, and consultation fee require confirmation.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular or starting one-vial public prices; promotional two-vial pricing was excluded.
estimates.limitations: One value is a starting price and total course uses multiple vials.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared two regular public face-session prices; trial and package values were excluded.
estimates.limitations: One clinic publishes 'from'; tip, anesthesia, and face-and-neck scope may alter the quote.

estimates.methodology_note: Used regular public face-session values; the midpoint represented Four Seasons' weekday/weekend Signature Supreme range.
estimates.limitations: Protocols range from short clinic facials to a 75-minute hotel-spa service; promotions and trial prices were excluded.

estimates.methodology_note: Compared Beauty Ranch's starting single-session full-face price with Deluxe Med Spa's regular full-face price. First-patient and package prices were excluded.
estimates.limitations: Only two current public sources qualified. Protocol, tip, area, anaesthesia, and provider can materially change a quote.

estimates.methodology_note: Used DermFX's $199 listed session, Shorr Beauty's $199 45-minute session, and Beauty Ranch's $285 regular price. Beauty Ranch's temporary $199 special was excluded.
estimates.limitations: Session duration, serum, extractions, dermaplaning, masks, and other add-ons differ among providers.
